reviewType: Focused narrative synthesis of multi-turn workload characterization, serving and decode-chip design methods; not an agent capability survey
focus: Coding/Work Agent multi-turn workloads and decode-chip implications: incremental prefill, context and KV state, pauses and restoration, P/D handoff, resource attribution and calibrated hardware design-space evaluation

focusGroups.name: 多轮负载特征与生产轨迹
工作流调度与跨层接口
全栈资源观测与服务基础
场景背景（不作为Workload分析主线）

works.name: AgentSysBench
works.title: From LLM Inference to Agentic Workloads: Characterization and Implications for Serving Systems
works.method: 统一工作负载/服务栈说明与多组件测量，并补充生产轨迹
works.measure: 端到端耗时、状态、资源与控制面行为
works.boundary: 受控执行与生产观察回答互补问题，不互相替代

works.name: AgentX Harness
works.title: AgentX Harness
works.method: 按轨迹长度和前缀共享结构回放模型请求
works.measure: 推理延迟、吞吐及缓存行为
works.boundary: 不自动恢复工具语义、真实等待或任务质量

works.name: PagedAttention
works.title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
works.method: 分页式KV块管理及共享
works.measure: 显存管理效率与推理吞吐
works.boundary: 缓存管理机制，不是完整Agent任务基准

works.name: TraceLab
works.title: TraceLab: Characterizing Coding Agent Workloads for LLM Serving
works.method: 真实Claude Code/Codex日志归一为session—用户请求—模型step，保留时间、token与工具元数据
works.measure: 自主循环长度、上下文增长、append/new输入、工具长尾、跨用户间隙缓存复用
works.boundary: 开发者样本与特定提供商；append包含缓存未命中的旧历史，不等于全新信息

works.name: Agentic Coding in the Wild
works.title: Agentic Coding in the Wild: Characterizing GitHub Copilot Traces at Production Scale
works.method: GitHub Copilot生产轨迹，区分用户轮次与轮内工具驱动循环
works.measure: 轮内/跨轮命中、工具间隙与用户空闲、模型切换及压缩边界
works.boundary: 生产观测存在模型、路由和用户混杂；跨轮命中下降不自动等于HBM容量不足

works.name: Agentic AI Workload Characteristics
works.title: Agentic AI Workload Characteristics
works.method: 贯通Agent侧与推理服务的端到端跟踪，比较模型与推理配置
works.measure: 重复模型进入、缓存后的prefill/decode、工具读写阶段与持续KV状态
works.boundary: 缓存后decode占优是所测条件的观察，不是所有Agent部署的定律

works.name: CacheWise
works.title: CacheWise: Understanding Workloads and Optimizing KVCache Management for Efficiently Serving LLM Coding Agents
works.method: 真实coding轨迹分析，结合前缀感知调度与工具元数据预测复用
works.measure: KV驱逐/重算、命中与整session完成时间
works.boundary: 收益依赖负载与资源；较高命中率本身不保证更好整题时间

works.name: Continuum
works.title: Continuum: Efficient and Robust Multi-Turn LLM Agent Scheduling with KV Cache Time-to-Live
works.method: 按恢复成本与排队影响选择性设置KV驻留TTL，结合程序级调度
works.measure: 轮间等待、恢复开销、job完成时间、预测不准时的稳健性
works.boundary: 不能无限保留所有等待会话；需在复用与挤占活跃请求间权衡

works.name: Autellix
works.title: Autellix: An Efficient Serving Engine for LLM Agents as General Programs
works.method: 将程序身份及已完成调用的服务信息送入调度器
works.measure: 累计排队、队首阻塞、程序完成延迟和吞吐
works.boundary: 程序感知调度不同于只调单请求batch；非所有流程都预先已知

works.name: HEAR
works.title: Can Agent Harnesses and Inference Engines Hear Each Other? The HEAR Protocol for Agentic LLM Serving
works.method: 双向交换harness的工作流/生命周期意图与engine的队列/KV状态
works.measure: 缓存协同、运行模式、端到端延迟及质量约束
works.boundary: 协议不是固定优化策略；研究任务中的收益不等于已在本地接入

works.name: CPU-Centric Perspective
works.title: Towards Understanding, Analyzing, and Optimizing Agentic AI Execution: A CPU-Centric Perspective
works.method: 跨两类硬件刻画CPU/GPU执行，研究重叠微批与混合负载调度
works.measure: 工具/编排CPU瓶颈、重叠、异构请求队首阻塞
works.boundary: 包括相邻Agent任务，不能把其CPU瓶颈直接套到每个coding/办公任务

works.name: Architectural Implications
works.title: Architectural Implications of Agentic AI Workflows
works.method: Azure生产观察与受控框架实验结合，按执行结构和资源角色分析
works.measure: CPU—GPU碎片化、突发、局部性、角色化资源与状态换入
works.boundary: 负载受框架、任务、工具和模型组成共同影响，利用率相关不替代干预

works.name: Cortex
works.title: Cortex: Workflow-Aware Resource Pooling and Scheduling for Agentic Serving
works.method: 原型按工作流阶段隔离资源池并定制调度
works.measure: 阶段间计算/内存干扰、KV利用和吞吐可预测性
works.boundary: 原型与阶段分解有适用边界，不是已证明的通用生产最佳方案

works.name: TokenCake
works.title: TokenCake: A KV-Cache-centric Serving Framework for LLM-based Multi-Agent Applications
works.method: 工具等待时卸载/预测换入KV，按图结构和运行状态安排内存
works.measure: 空闲缓存挤占、关键路径代理被驱逐、整工作流耗时
works.boundary: 用于有依赖的多Agent工作流；四个独立客户端并发不等于其执行拓扑

works.name: AgentSight
works.title: AgentSight: System-Level Observability for AI Agents Using eBPF
works.method: 在边界关联LLM通信与eBPF内核事件
works.measure: 跨进程语义—动作观测与诊断
works.boundary: 观测工具不是任务正确性的验收器

works.name: SGLang
works.title: SGLang: Efficient Execution of Structured Language Model Programs
works.method: 结构化程序前端与RadixAttention前缀复用运行时
works.measure: 多调用程序的执行效率
works.boundary: 前缀复用不等于跨会话事实记忆正确性

works.name: Parrot
works.title: Parrot: Efficient Serving of LLM-based Applications with Semantic Variable
works.method: Semantic Variable暴露请求之间的数据流依赖
works.measure: 应用端到端服务表现
works.boundary: 需要应用信息，不等价于只调单请求batch大小

works.name: InferCept
works.title: InferCept: Efficient Intercept Support for Augmented Large Language Model Inference
works.method: 围绕外部交互暂停选择保留、换出或重算上下文
works.measure: 状态占用与恢复/服务效率权衡
works.boundary: 策略收益依赖等待时长、链路和资源条件

works.name: SWE-bench
works.title: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?
works.method: 根据仓库问题生成修复并通过测试验收
works.measure: 问题是否解决
works.boundary: 不是按补丁文本相似度或自报完成打分

works.name: Terminal-Bench 2.0
works.title: Terminal-Bench: Benchmarking Agents on Hard, Realistic Tasks in Command Line Interfaces
works.method: 独立终端环境中执行真实任务并运行验证测试
works.measure: 终态产物及测试是否通过
works.boundary: 此处明确为2.0论文，不混用不同代任务集合

works.name: WorkArena
works.title: WorkArena: How Capable Are Web Agents at Solving Common Knowledge Work Tasks?
works.method: ServiceNow企业应用任务与BrowserGym交互环境
works.measure: 知识工作中的业务操作完成
works.boundary: 需控制网页状态、业务记录与观察/动作接口

works.name: TheAgentCompany
works.title: TheAgentCompany: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Consequential Real World Tasks
works.method: 模拟公司内跨网站、代码、程序与同事通信
works.measure: 数字员工能否交付真实工作任务
works.boundary: 需要跨应用终态，不能只看某次工具调用成功

works.name: PPD
works.title: Not All Prefills Are Equal: PPD Disaggregation for Multi-turn LLM Serving
works.method: 测量完整/增量prefill对decode的干扰，动态选择后续轮次的P端或D端执行
works.measure: 后续轮次TTFT、TPOT干扰与KV传输拥塞
works.boundary: 其canonical基线假设单向P到D交接；不能推广为所有PD协议均重算完整历史，也不能直接推定ASIC算力配比
works.evidenceType: GPU system measurements and dynamic-routing evaluation

works.name: AMPD
works.title: Efficient Multi-round LLM Inference over Disaggregated Serving
works.method: 联合离线代价建模、部署规划与在线增量prefill路由/重排
works.measure: TTFT/ITL约束、历史KV访问、增量KV返回与资源配置
works.boundary: 远端P必要时先读取D的历史KV；仅回传增量不等于无历史传输。本地暂停decode是其实现行为，非所有硬件必然如此
works.evidenceType: GPU system measurements and deployment/scheduling evaluation

works.name: vLLM DCP
works.authors: Seonghee Lee and Sungsoo Ha and Omri Almog and Lucas Wilkinson
works.title: Efficient Decode Context Parallelism with vLLM for Long Context Workloads
works.method: 固定模型/硬件/负载，比较TP与按序列切分KV的decode context parallelism
works.measure: 长上下文KV占用、并发、吞吐—交互速度与collective通信
works.boundary: 官方工程测量，非同行评审论文；KV复制取决于模型和并行实现，不能直接套到V4.1或目标ASIC
works.evidenceType: Official engineering measurements on a specified GPU deployment

works.name: HeteroPanacea
works.title: When Does Disaggregation Pay? Simulating Prefill--Decode--Attention--FFN Specialization for Agentic LLM Inference
works.method: 以分阶段roofline/互连模型搜索P/D与Attention/FFN异构配置及精度
works.measure: 受功耗或成本约束的配置收益与模型架构敏感性
works.boundary: 自定义NPU结果是模拟；组件校验不等于端到端调度已验证。固定中心长度的合成负载不能代替真实轮间轨迹
works.evidenceType: Simulation with component-level GPU validation; not measured custom silicon

works.name: LLMCompass
works.authors: Hengrui Zhang and August Ning and Rohan Baskar Prabhakar and David Wentzlaff
works.title: LLMCompass: Enabling Efficient Hardware Design for Large Language Model Inference
works.method: 联合硬件模型、算子映射/调度搜索与面积成本模型进行设计空间评估
works.measure: 算子/模型延迟、计算与内存配置的成本—性能取舍
works.boundary: 通用LLM硬件评估方法，不是Agent轨迹研究；目标MLA/稀疏/MoE算子和动态服务行为须另行扩展、校准
works.evidenceType: Hardware modeling framework with measured-platform validation
